The Detailed Accident Report (DAR) was filed on 20.05.2023 and was registered as a Motor Accident Claim petition.
The DAR revealed that a Road Traffic Accident took place on 19.02.2023 at about 10.45 PM, DDU Marg, Near Shochalya in front of gate of Hathi Park, Delhi wherein Sh. Nitin had sustained injury.

The accident took place with the vehicle bearing registration No. DL-IZA-9674 driven rashly and negligently as well as owned by respondent no.1, Nand Kishore and insured with respondent no.2, Reliance General Insurance.
BRIEF FACTS OF THE CASE 2.

Based on the facts outlined in the DAR, it emerges that on receipt of the information of the accident in question vide DD No. 77A dt. 19.02.2023 ASI Sandeep Singh along with Ct. Nitin went to the spot where he found the vehicles bearing No. UP14EK6476 and DL1ZA9674 were stationed in an accidental condition and PCR caller ASI Divender.
Further, ASI Divender handed over Sh. Nand Kishore i.e. driver of the offending vehicle to IO.
Thereafter, injured was taken to the hospital by the PCR Van.
IO went to the hospital after handing over the driver of the offending to Constable.
Further, IO collected the MLC bearing No. 11518859/23 from the hospital.
Thereafter, IO came to know that the injured had fled away from the hospital.
IO again came at the spot and took the photographs of the same.
Further, IO took both the vehicles into his custody and deposited them into Malkhana.
Thereafter, IO recorded the statement of caller.
Further, FIR was registered under RUCHIKA SINGLA Section 279/337 IPC on the basis of statement of caller.
Further, IO interrogated the driver of the offending vehicle.
He said that he was the owner of the offending vehicle and he himself was driving the same at the time of the accident.
Further, driver of the offending vehicle produced the documents of the offending vehicle and DL to the IO and IO took them into his custody.
Thereafter, he was arrested and released on bail as the offence was bailable.
Further, IO prepared the site plan of the same.
Thereafter, IO got conducted the mechanical inspection of both the accidental vehicles.
Further, IO verified the documents of the offending vehicle i.e. DL, RC and insurance and it was found correct.
3. During the course of the investigation, IO submitted the MLCs of the injured for final opinion and as per final opinion, on the MLCs of injured , the injury was 'Grievous'.
Accordingly, offence u/s. 337 IPC was changed to u/s.338 IPC.
Thereafter, IO recorded the statement of injured.

Further,
offending vehicle was released on superdari.

WRITTEN STATEMENTS 4.

However, it was stated that the accident was caused due to the rash and negligent driving of the petitioner.
